name: Dragonrider
introduce:
DD-360 Dragonrider
A heavy ST manufactured by Dole Industries.
The shoulders feature an aberrant Steelstorm frame design with an expanded variable-liquid core. It can maximize shoulder kinetic output according to the pilot's combat habits, enabling more powerful and agile melee strikes.

30048.name: Matching Mod
30048.SpecificEffects:
When initiating combat, if the target can retaliate, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-18%</color>;
After initiating combat, restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>25%</color> of damage dealt.

20204.name: Enlightenment Core
20204.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a skill that costs <color=#F74848>3</color> AP or more, DMG <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>. For every additional AP consumed, effect <color=#F74848>+2%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>16%</color>.
